title: AutoOntic: Automatic Ontology Induction from Text for Knowledge Graph Construction
abstract: arXiv:2611.15467v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation depends on the quality of the knowledge graph (KG) it retrieves over, yet schema-free LLM-based extraction pipelines typically produce flat graphs: deduplicated entities and relations with no type hierarchy and no domain/range constraints. We present AutoOntic, a pipeline that automatically constructs an ontology from text by canonicalizing open-vocabulary entity types and relations, inducing a hierarchy over the canonicalized types, and mining relation-level domain and range constraints. Its hierarchy induction procedure prioritizes types using corpus-derived relation-argument profiles and places them through local, LLM-adjudicated parent/child checks, allowing newly inserted types to trigger reassignment of existing parent-child links. translated_title: AutoOntic：面向知识图谱构建的从文本自动归纳本体
translated_abstract: 基于图的检索增强生成依赖于其检索所用的知识图谱（KG）的质量，然而基于LLM的无模式抽取流水线通常产生扁平化的图：仅有去重后的实体和关系，缺乏类型层次结构，也没有域/范围约束。我们提出了AutoOntic，一个从文本自动构建本体的流水线，它对开放词表的实体类型和关系进行规范化，在规范化类型之上归纳层次结构，并挖掘关系级别的域和范围约束。其层次归纳程序利用语料库导出的关系-参数画像对类型进行优先排序，并通过局部的、由LLM裁定的父子关系检查来放置类型，允许新插入的类型触发对现有父子链接的重新分配。所生成的层次结构约束实体去重，并支持关系级别域/范围约束的归纳。对于内在评估，我们（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: AutoOntic提出了一种从文本自动构建本体的流水线，通过规范化实体类型与关系、归纳类型层次结构并挖掘关系级域/范围约束，从而提升知识图谱的质量以支撑图结构检索增强生成。
en_tdlr: AutoOntic presents a pipeline that automatically induces ontologies from text by canonicalizing open-vocabulary entity types and relations, inducing type hierarchies with LLM-adjudicated parent/child checks, and mining relation-level domain/range constraints to improve knowledge graph quality for graph-based RAG.
